race.comment: BOLE LE (5) dropped a touch in grade and improved last start, leading for home and just failing to hang on here in a similar race to this. Draws a little better this time and should be at his peak after four runs back from a spell. SIR GOLDALOT (6) is knocking on the door with a couple of big finishes to fill minor placings recently, the latest over the mile at the Sunshine Coast. Has won two races and both came here at this evening's trip. Right in contention. SO YOU CAN TORQUE (7) won two back over 1500m at Warwick then tackled the same course and distance last time but lost his chance with a poor getaway. Can bounce back. MALECON (2) is resuming from a spell and is a previous winner at this track and distance. Include.
